scenario_brief: Hearth Hub went offline (orange light pulsing) after the internet provider installed a new router; setting it up again fails at the Wi-Fi step.
reference_answer: This is a known issue: Hearth Hub firmware before 5.1 does not support WPA3-only Wi-Fi security, which new or updated routers often use. In your router settings, set Wi-Fi security to WPA2/WPA3 mixed (also called WPA3 transition mode). The hub will then reconnect and update itself to firmware 5.1, after which WPA3-only also works.

body: Hi Mark, I was charged extra fees by the courier for my order from the Canadian store. I already have the receipt showing I paid these charges, but there's no indication of a refund or credit in my Quillfen account yet.
scenario_brief: Customer in Canada was asked by the courier to pay duties and a brokerage fee for an Aria Max order from the Canadian store. They paid it and have the receipt.
reference_answer: Prices in the Canadian store include duties and taxes, so you should not have been charged. Keep the courier's receipt and submit a customs refund claim in Account > Orders > Get help > Customs fee within 60 days of delivery. We refund the full amount to your original payment method within 5 business days of approval.

subject: DISAPPOINTING: Thinking of returning the Aria Max
body: I cannot believe how bad this works, I bought the Aria Max for $200 and I cant even get basic noise cancelling on a train. The ANC button turns on but i can still hear everything clearly so it is useless to me. I am seriously thinking of never ordering from Quillfen again because my trust has been completely broken.
scenario_brief: Aria Max noise cancelling seems weak: customer can still hear a lot on the train. The ANC button works and switches modes. Customer wears glasses.
reference_answer: Noise cancelling depends on a good seal around your ears. Check that the ear cushions are seated correctly and that the mode is set to Noise cancelling (not Transparency) with the ANC button or in the QuillCloud app. Glasses frames can break the seal, so try adjusting the headband position. If it is still weak with a good seal, contact us for further checks.

subject: Issue with newsletter code on gift card purchase
body: Hello, I received my 10% newsletter welcome code last week and tried to apply it while purchasing a gift card today, but I'm getting an error message stating the code is invalid. My order number is QF-482913. Could you please check why this valid promotional code isn't working on the website? I would appreciate your help resolving this quickly as I am in a hurry to complete my purchase.
scenario_brief: Customer who is NOT a Plus member tries to use a 10% newsletter welcome code to buy a gift card and gets an error. Code was received last week.
reference_answer: Promo codes, including the newsletter welcome code, cannot be used to buy gift cards. The welcome code is valid for 30 days on Quillfen-brand products for your first order, so you can still use it on an eligible product.

subject: Return request for Nimbus 14 - Restocking fee inquiry
body: I am writing on behalf of my small firm regarding the Nimbus 14 we purchased for evaluation. Since we have changed our minds about integrating this device into our workflow, we would like to initiate a return process immediately. Could you please clarify if there is any restocking fee associated with this transaction and what the estimated refund amount will be? We require a detailed breakdown by tomorrow afternoon.
scenario_brief: Customer in Germany (EU), not a Plus member, received a Nimbus 14 laptop 10 days ago, opened and used it, changed their mind. Asks how much they will get back and whether there is a restocking fee.
reference_answer: You can return it: in the EU you have a 14-day right of withdrawal from delivery, even for opened items, and no restocking fee applies within those 14 days. Because this is a change-of-mind return and you are not a Plus member, the €4.99 return label fee is deducted, so you get the item price back minus €4.99. Start the return in Account > Orders > Return item.

subject: Question about return policy for Nimbus 14 - change of mind
body: I hope you can help me out since my day has been absolutely chaotic; I just had to rush to the office, miss a meeting due to traffic, and now I'm stuck at home. Anyway, my friend accidentally left a small scratch on his Nimbus 14 earlier that day, but he said it's fine as long as the screen is clear. Actually, no one touched it, I opened it myself today because I got excited about the specs. It works perfectly for me right now, but I've changed my mind about buying the laptop for work. Since I'm not a Quillfen Plus member and it has been exactly 20 days, what percentage of the price will they deduct from my refund if I want to return it now?
scenario_brief: Customer in the US, not a Plus member, opened a Nimbus 14 and wants to return it for change of mind 20 days after delivery. It works fine. Asks what will be deducted.
reference_answer: You are within the 30-day return window, so the return is accepted. Because the laptop was opened and is returned for change of mind more than 14 days after delivery, a 15% restocking fee applies, and the $5.99 return label fee is also deducted. You will get the price minus 15% and minus $5.99.

subject: Issue with Aria Buds fitting
body: Hello Support Team, I am writing regarding order number QF-482913 placed in the UK. My wife and I purchased the Aria Buds five days ago, and while we love the sound quality, the fit is problematic once the silicone ear tips are removed during testing. We would like to exercise our 14-day right of return policy as the current configuration does not stay in place securely.
scenario_brief: Customer in the UK received Aria Buds 5 days ago, tried them on (so the ear tip seal is broken), they work fine but do not fit well. Wants to use their 14-day right to return.
reference_answer: Unfortunately Aria Buds cannot be returned once the hygiene seal on the ear tips is broken, unless they are faulty. This exception also applies during the UK 14-day withdrawal period. Since they work correctly, they cannot be returned for fit. If you notice a fault, you can make a warranty claim.

subject: Urgent: Aria Max pricing discrepancy?
body:
Hello,

I'm feeling quite worried about my recent purchase of the Aria Max in the UK; I bought it from you a week ago but just saw a 'lightning deal' at another electronics shop that is 25% cheaper and ends tonight.

Could you please explain why your price hasn't dropped while theirs has? Also, do I get a full refund, partial credit towards my cart, or will this be handled automatically when the deal expires?

I need to know all three options available to me right now so I can decide what to do next.
scenario_brief: Customer bought Aria Max 10 days ago and now sees it cheaper in a competitor's 'lightning deal' that ends tonight. Wants a price match. Quillfen's own price has not changed.
reference_answer: Unfortunately we cannot match this price, because flash or lightning deals are excluded from our price match policy. If the Quillfen price of the Aria Max drops within 14 days of your purchase (30 days for Plus members), you can request the difference.

subject: My camera does not work
body: Hello support team, I buy Lumen Cam in Spain 20 months ago and now it no turn on with any cable or adapter. I think warranty expired because only one year is good. Please help me fix this problem.
scenario_brief: Customer in Spain (EU) has a Lumen Cam bought 20 months ago that no longer powers on with any cable or adapter. Not a Plus member. Assumes the warranty has expired after one year.
reference_answer: In the EU, Quillfen-brand products have a 2-year legal guarantee from delivery, so your Lumen Cam is still covered at 20 months. Make a warranty claim in Account > Orders > Get help > Warranty claim with the serial number. After remote checks, we will repair or replace it.

subject: Weather forecast for Paris broken
body: I tried to look up the weather in Paris tomorrow and you just gave me gibberish. This is ridiculous, especially when I'm planning my trip from Toronto. Just give me the actual forecast or close this ticket.
scenario_brief: Person asks what the weather will be in Paris tomorrow.
